Position Overview
Are You a Performance-Driven Strategist Who Knows How to Make Google & YouTube Ads Scale?
If you thrive on performance data, love solving ROAS puzzles, and know how to build and scale high-converting campaigns on Google and YouTube, this could be your next big move.
We’re looking for a strategic thinker who can own and scale a multi-million-dollar search engine account. You’ll be responsible for campaign strategy, performance optimization, and growing Google ad spend into the multi-millions, while launching YouTube as a standalone acquisition channel.
This isn’t a plug-and-play role. We want someone who owns results, makes decisive moves, and isn’t afraid to be accountable for outcomes. If you need step-by-step direction or shy away from taking full responsibility, this isn’t the role for you.
Responsibilities
Budget Management & Channel Scaling
Manage and optimize a $600K/month Google Ads engine, with ~$500K allocated to Search and Performance Max.
Take ownership of scaling Google ad spend from six figures to multi-millions while maintaining strong performance metrics.
Build and grow YouTube as its own high-performing acquisition channel, developing a strategy tailored to its unique strengths.
Ensure efficient budget allocation across campaigns, balancing aggressive growth with disciplined ROI targets.
Forecast performance, scale winners, and pull back on underperformers with confidence and speed.
Campaign Strategy & Execution
Own the full lifecycle of Google and YouTube ad campaigns—from planning and launch to optimization and scaling.
Execute both search and video strategies using Google Ads and YouTube Ads Manager.
Set up advanced audience targeting, keyword strategies, bidding models, and exclusions.
Build and manage campaigns across multiple products and funnels, ensuring high efficiency and profitability.
Performance Optimization
Analyze campaign data daily to identify trends, diagnose performance issues, and uncover opportunities.
Optimize key metrics including CTR, CPC, ROAS, conversion rate, and CPA.
Rapidly test and iterate on creatives, headlines, calls to action, and landing page combinations.
Collaborate with our creative team to brief and test new video and static assets.
Creative & Funnel Collaboration
Partner with the creative team to ensure video scripts and visuals are optimized for YouTube’s first 5 seconds and beyond.
Provide feedback on hooks, visual pacing, and CTA integration based on performance data.
Align paid traffic with appropriate landing pages, upsells, and conversion paths.
Industry Knowledge
Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and new ad formats for Google and YouTube.
Bring new strategies, trends, and tactics to the table that keep us ahead of the competition.
Requirements
5+ years running paid Google and/or YouTube campaigns
Proven experience managing a minimum of $1 million dollars of ad spend in Google and YouTube
Proven experience growing ad spend
Proven track record of scaling performance with ROAS and CAC accountability
Deep understanding of Google Ads platform, YouTube Ads, and audience segmentation
Strong data literacy and ability to interpret performance metrics to drive decision-making
Experience with attribution models and tracking setups (GA4, UTMs, etc.)
Comfortable writing or editing ad copy for performance, not just branding
Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
Experience using tools like Google Ads Editor, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, etc.
Familiarity with AI tools to streamline analysis or creative ideation is a plus
Additional requirements:
Willingness to work US time zones, regardless of geographic location.
Access to a computer
Reliable internet connection
Reliable and distraction-free work environment
Must be fluent in English (read/write/speak)
Offer Details
This is a full-time, remote contractor role that is open to international candidates. Pay is competitive and based on experience, skill level, and geographic location.

title: Legal Counsel (Commercial Contracting)

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

About The Role:
At YipitData, our legal team is an essential and collaborative partner in the Company’s growth. As
Counsel, Commercial Contracts , you will work with our commercial teams to review, draft, and manage a wide variety of commercial contracts: non-disclosure agreements, vendor and partnership agreements, services agreements and statements of work, and customer agreements.

Develop contract negotiation and drafting skills to manage a wide variety of commercial matters for YipitData, including contracts with vendors, partners, and customers.
Learn in a rapidly changing environment by navigating new problems and conceiving novel contracting frameworks when needed.
Respond promptly to legal requests from Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, Human Resources, and other internal clients to facilitate contract review, support their business needs and communicate legal issues in clear and concise terms.
Enhance processes, efficiency, and best practices, including ongoing improvements to contract templates and contract management processes.
Evaluate and advise on appropriate legal courses of action to meet Company and business unit needs.
You Are Likely To Succeed If:
3-5 years of experience as a practicing attorney at a law firm or in-house.
You are excited by and highly determined to work on commercial contracts. You have a passion for drafting, negotiating, and redlining and are eager to further develop these skills.
Your attention to detail is stellar.
You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy working cross-functionally.
You thrive in the unknown, are motivated to think creatively each day and can handle new areas of responsibility independently.
Experience drafting and negotiating US business contracts is strongly preferred.
Nice to have:
You have a law degree (JD or LLM) from a top law school in the United States, are licensed to practice and a member of good standing of a United States bar, and have the appropriate practical knowledge, skills and abilities acquired through 3-5 years of relevant experience.
This is an exciting opportunity for a top law firm associate or experienced attorney at a high-growth tech or data product company with strong communication skills and impeccable judgment.
What We Offer:
Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
Flexible work schedule
Personal laptop
Health and wellness package
Remote work
Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

description:

is
the
enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.

world’s top system integrators .

You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
Create and maintain data load programs.
Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
Support and mentor junior colleagues.

Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
Functional ERP experience.
Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
Customer facing skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.

Autonomy and Trust:
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
Growth Opportunities:
We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
Collaborative Support:
We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
Diversity of Stories:
Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
Recognition:
We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
Open Organization:
We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Video Editor - Content
description:
Job Opening – Video Editor – Content Department
Location:
Rio de Janeiro (on-site position)
Company:
Nosso Futebol - Sporty Group
Nosso Futebol, part of Sporty Group, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.
Role Overview:
As a Video Editor at Nosso Futebol, you will be responsible for editing and enhancing audiovisual content related to sports events and programs. You will play a key role in supporting the channel's content team by delivering high-quality video materials aligned with our editorial standards and audience expectations.
Requirements:
Previous experience with video editing, preferably for sports media platforms (directly or indirectly);
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere and Photoshop;
Solid knowledge of sports, especially soccer and Olympic disciplines; familiarity with national clubs and championships, as well as major international clubs and competitions;
Ability to write captions and perform video logging (shot listing/scene breakdown);
Reading comprehension in English (additional languages are a plus).
Candidate Profile:
Strong interpersonal and communication skills;
Creativity and an eye for detail;
Flexibility to take on new tasks;
Proactive attitude and team spirit
—---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vaga – Editor de Vídeos – Área de Conteúdo
Local:
Rio de Janeiro (modelo presencial)
Empresa:
Nosso Futebol
Visão Geral da Função:
Como Editor de Vídeos no Nosso Futebol, você será responsável pela edição e tratamento de conteúdo audiovisual relacionado a eventos e programas esportivos. Você terá um papel fundamental no apoio à equipe de conteúdo do canal, entregando materiais de vídeo de alta qualidade, alinhados aos padrões editoriais e às expectativas do público.
Requisitos:
Experiência prévia com edição de vídeo, preferencialmente para plataformas de mídia esportiva (direta ou indiretamente);
Domínio das ferramentas Adobe Premiere e Photoshop;
Conhecimento sólido em esportes, especialmente futebol e modalidades olímpicas; familiaridade com clubes e campeonatos nacionais, além dos principais clubes e competições internacionais;
Capacidade de elaborar textos e realizar decupagem de vídeos;
Leitura em inglês (outros idiomas serão considerados um diferencial).
Perfil do Candidato:
Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
Criatividade e atenção aos detalhes;
Flexibilidade para assumir novas tarefas;
Proatividade e espírito de equipe.

4. Set-up Interest Rate Curves & other market data

6. Set-up Equity Volatility Surface feeds

• 3+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso
• Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets

industry focus.
Other Required Skills:
- Ability to work with little supervision, be a fast learner, self-motivated, team player, and collaborator with strong problem-solving
skills.
- Must be resourceful and demonstrate initiative in getting the job done.
- Good oral and written communication skills are essential.
- Ability to train and transfer knowledge to Guardian's business and technology stakeholders
• Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects
• Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects
- Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU

  • Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management
  • Leadership skills
  • Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.
  • Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills
  • Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment

Elaboração de Solução Educacional e Cronograma;

Participação em treinamentos internos para autodesenvolvimento;
Possibilidade de acompanhamento das atividades presenciais no cliente;
Relacionamento direto com o cliente em reuniões e ao longo do desenvolvimento, apoio ao conteudista no desenvolvimento do conteúdo e desenvolvimento da equipe em relação ao conteúdo técnico educacional.
Deve ter autonomia nas entregas e propor soluções diferenciadas, buscando constantemente novas formas de promover o trabalho e atividades (softwares, processos e atividades que otimizam ou inovam o desempenho), promoção de comitês e reuniões para trocas e inovações.

Experiência anterior como Designer Instrucional, com foco em educação corporativa;
Experiência no uso das metodologias ágeis
Experiência em Storytelling e gamificação;

Apoiamos nossos funcionários, não importa quem sejam ou de onde venham, porque todos nós temos perspectivas e abordagens valiosas e exclusivas. Somos mais que um supermercado!
A startup que já economizou mais de R$ 30 milhões a milhares de brasileiros e dobra de tamanho a cada 3 meses, desde sua fundação (em 2015). Em 2021 conseguimos levantar cerca de R$300 milhões em duas rodadas de investimento com gente fora da curva, como José Galló (ex-CEO da Renner), GIC, Ariel Lambrecht (fundador da 99 e da Yellow), Minerva Foods, entre outros. Acreditamos que um país melhor é feito de empresas mais eficientes e de pessoas que trocam velhos hábitos por escolhas mais inteligentes. E trabalhamos por isso. Por essa visão de país melhor, aplicada ao setor que atinge a todos os brasileiros: o setor de produtos essenciais de consumo, mais conhecido como "setor supermercadista". Mas esqueça esse nome: "supermercado". Somos mais que isso. Somos um sistema de reabastecimento. E queremos ser o maior e melhor sistema de reabastecimento do Brasil. Esse é nosso sonho. "Um mundo onde os produtos essenciais cheguem na sua casa com a mesma facilidade que a água chega na torneira". Quer participar desse sonho com a gente?

Revisar procedimentos internos via Greendocs, com base em auditorias e inspeções;

Garantir a execução e o monitoramento dos planos de ação dos PGRTAs.

title: Product Owner Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de um
Product Owner
para se juntar à nossa Squad de produtos digitais, com foco em dados e inteligência artificial. O profissional será responsável por liderar a definição da visão do produto, priorizar o backlog e garantir que a equipe esteja alinhada às metas estratégicas da empresa.
Se você tem um forte entendimento técnico na área de dados e inteligência artificial, além de habilidades de liderança e comunicação, essa é a oportunidade ideal para você =)
Responsabilidades:
- Definir e comunicar a visão do produto, garantindo que as necessidades dos stakeholders e dos usuários finais sejam atendidas.
- Priorizar e gerenciar o backlog do produto, assegurando que as histórias de usuários e requisitos estejam bem definidos e compreendidos pela equipe.
- Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo desenvolvedores, designers e analistas de dados, para entregar soluções inovadoras e de alto valor.
- Realizar reuniões de planejamento, revisões e retrospectivas, garantindo que a equipe esteja sempre alinhada e motivada.
- Monitorar métricas de desempenho do produto e realizar análises para identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
- Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado e inovações em dados e inteligência artificial, trazendo insights e recomendações para a equipe.

- Experiência como Product Owner ou em funções similares, preferencialmente em produtos digitais focados em dados e inteligência artificial.
- Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban.
- Compreensão técnica de dados, incluindo modelagem, integração e análise de dados.
- Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados e visualização (ex: Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
- Conhecimento em machine learning, algoritmos de inteligência artificial e suas aplicações em produtos digitais.
- Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de produtos (ex: Jira, Trello, etc.).
Competências:
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, com capacidade de articular conceitos complexos de forma clara e acessível.
- Habilidade em liderança e motivação de equipes, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e produtivo.
- Pensamento analítico e resolução de problemas, com habilidade para tomar decisões informadas com base em dados.
- Capacidade de priorizar tarefas e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente em um ambiente dinâmico.
- Adaptabilidade e abertura para aprender novas habilidades e tecnologias.

title: QA Performance Engineer
description:

About you
We are looking for an experienced QA Performance Engineer responsible for planning, implementing and monitoring quality assurance strategies and procedures to give our clients the best service to ensure the non-functional requirements for performance are met.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
4 years (minimum) as a QA analyst.
Experience with Azure services and distributed systems
Knowledge of performance testing and proven experience developing automated test cases using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, etc.
Understanding of REST APIs and network performance concepts
Knowledge of Azure Monitor, App Insights, Grafana.
Scripting with Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript.
Version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD integration.

Support the selection and implementation of automation tools (JMeter, NeoLoad, LoadRunner).

  • Docker: Containerização de aplicações, criação de imagens e integração com ambientes orquestrados. (Obrigatório)
  • GitHub: Versionamento de código, uso de pull requests, GitHub Actions e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.
  • APIs REST/GraphQL: Criação e consumo de APIs performáticas e seguras.

  • Resiliência e responsabilidade: Vivência com ambientes críticos, alta disponibilidade e foco em soluções confiáveis.

title: PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS JR - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.
Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.
Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
O Engenheiro de Dados Júnior será responsável por colaborar na concepção, construção e manutenção de soluções de processamento de dados e armazenamento na nuvem. Trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outros membros da equipe de dados e tecnologia para garantir que os dados sejam capturados, armazenados, processados e disponibilizados para uso interno e pelos nossos clientes.
+ Será responsável por entender os dados e gerar indicadores/KPI’S;

  • Participar dos estudos de novas tecnologias de mercado associadas a Engenharia de Dados (Visualização, ETL, Armazentamento ...)
  • Realizar desenvolvimento e correções de mapas e workflows em ferramentas de ETL (Ex.: Airflow), testes unitários e integrados, monitoramento;
  • Correção de execuções em bases de dados;
  • Preparação para deploy de mapas e workflows, parametrização de fluxos e mapeamentos com armazenamento de parâmetros em base externa;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar etapas de homologação dos projetos que envolvam dados;
    Requisitos:
  • Conhecimento básico com plataformas na nuvem, como Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Compreensão básica de ferramentas e tecnologias de business intelligence (DW/BI)
  • Experiência na função de Analista BI/ETL é um deferencial
  • Habilidade na estruturação e modelagem de dados – tabelas e projetos, relacional ou multidimensional;
  • Conhecimento básico em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, como Google Bigtable;
  • Habilidade em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação, como Python ou Java, e habilidade em aprender outras linguagens rapidamente;
  • Conhecimento de GitHub (ou ferramentas correlatas para execussão de Pull Requests, controle de versão, etc);
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de criação de pipelines (ex.: DBT, Informática PowerCenter, Airflow)

Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.

title: [Interaction Platform] SWE Manager - Mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?
A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.
Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.
Nossa cultura:
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It:
Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride:
Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit:
Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play:
Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason:
O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
O time de Interaction Platform:
A tribo de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.
Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas mobile e os padrões de experiência globais através da adoção KMP viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.
Como é ser uma pessoa Engineering Manager:
Ser Engineering Manager na Stone significa liderar equipes de engenharia de software, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados. É esperado que você atue como facilitador, garantindo que os times tenham clareza de propósito e os recursos necessários para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. Além disso, você será responsável por alinhar as metas técnicas com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, promovendo o crescimento profissional dos membros da equipe e fomentando uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo. Além de:
Liderar e desenvolver times de engenharia, com foco em alta performance e crescimento individual.
Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa, propagando e conectando direcionamento técnico alinhado a estrategia;
Garantir a entrega de soluções técnicas alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio, em parceria com PMs, Designers e outras lideranças.
Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e stakeholders, garantindo transparência e alinhamento.
Promover um ambiente de colaboração, segurança psicológica e feedback constante.
Garantir construção de estratégias técnicas dos domínios do time, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia (Clean Code, TDD, CI/CD, DevSecOps).
Participar da definição e acompanhamento de OKRs e métricas técnicas (lead time, estabilidade, cobertura de testes etc.).
Incentivar iniciativas de Inner Source, uso de RFCs e cultura de documentação viva.
Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções;
Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas do produto/plataforma;
Definir, coletar, analisar e acompanhar métricas de saúde de aplicações/produtos;
O que esperamos de você:
Experiência em liderança de times técnicos multidisciplinares baseado em princípios e adoção de metodologias ágeis (scrum / kanban);
Ser um embaixador no time da nossa cultura de alta colaboração e qualidade;
Experiência em ambiente com arquitetura robusta e escalável;
Fortes conhecimentos e experiência em liderança de times adotando padrões arquiteturais e design de código, padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
Experiência em desenvolvimento Mobile android/iOS;
Sólidos conhecimentos em API RESTful / Protocolo HTTP;
Sólidos conhecimentos sobre algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
Sólidos conhecimentos dos princípios SOLID, Clean Code e Design Patterns;
Experiência em investigações, troubleshooting, telemetria, monitoramento, observabilidade e depuração de sistemas em geral;
Experiência com Teste de Software: Unitário, integração, estresse, mutação e E2E;
Conhecimentos em bancos de dados e modelagens relacionais e não relacionais, estratégias de cache e processamento distribuído;
Conhecimentos sobre DevOps: CI/CD, automatizações e a cultura em si;
Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
Experiência em gestão de plataforma mobile (cliente dev interno).
O que aumenta as suas chances:
Experiência em gestão de times de experiência / jornada;
Experiência em gestão de times com responsabilidade em desenvolvimento de Design System;
Experiência com desenvolvimento KMP (Kotlin Multiplatform) e CMP(Compose Multiplatform);
Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações com React Native;
Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações backend com linguagens Golang, Node e C# ou outra linguagem moderna de backend (adicional);
Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e/ou apps de larga escala;
Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade.
Nossos benefícios:
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
Convênio SESC
Horário flexível
Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)
Gympass
Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
Salário Fixo + PLR
(quando preenchidos os requisitos)
Seguro de Vida
Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)
Etapas do Processo Seletivo:
Inscrição:
Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
Entrevistas com o time de People:
Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
Avaliação Técnica:
Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
Check de Cultura:
Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
Feedback:
Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone
Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Caso queira saber mais:
Confira nossa trilha de carreira para o time de tecnologia, a
Star Trail Tech .
Vem conhecer nosso time e aprender muito no nosso canal do
Youtube .
Temos vários artigos no
Medium .
Não deixe de dar uma conferida no nosso
Github .
Confira aqui as diretrizes do nosso
Código de Ética.
E pra ficar por dentro de todas as novidades, é só nos seguir no
Twitter .

Desejável inglês e espanhol;
Hands on e organização.

Experiência com cibersegurança, gestão de riscos, mitigação de vulnerabilidades e resposta a incidentes;
Capacidade de documentar e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de TI e segurança;
Vivência com monitoramento de ambiente cloud e on-premises;
Conhecimento de reportes e controles para auditorias (internas, externas e regulatórias);

title: Gerente Produto | Linha Amarela
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?
Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.
Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países
No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.
Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.
Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.
No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.
A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.
Como nosso Gerente de Produto, você irá:
Prospectar oportunidades comerciais para vendas de equipamentos de Linha Amarela;
Atuar na gestão, planejamento, controle e administração das estratégias, políticas, programas e regras estabelecidas para sua conta ou contas.
Gerencia a carteira de clientes estratégicos da área de linha amarela;
Promover ações e eventos de marketing para os principais stakeholders;
Atuar junto com a equipe de engenharia para comparação e efetividade dos equipamentos;
Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:
Forte experiência desenvolvimento de comunicação do produto;
Conhecimento com gestão de peças e serviços;
Ter carteira de clientes no seguimento de linha amarela;

title: Senior NLP/ML Software Engineer
description:
Our US-based client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.
They're seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This role is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.
This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to shape the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI and do it in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to hear from you.
Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with remote teams based in San Francisco, Copenhagen, Manila, and Ireland. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.
Responsibilities:
Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, Node.js, and TypeScript
Agile development experience and strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, etc.)
Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team
PREFERRED (But NOT Required):
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to enhance and maintain the infrastructure that powers our analytics and data products. In this role, you will be responsible for building and optimizing scalable data pipelines, ingesting data from various sources, and collaborating with teams to ensure the integrity, security, and accessibility of our data ecosystem.

Enhance and maintain the infrastructure powering our analytics and data products

Continuously monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness
Work closely with business stakeholders, including Analysts and Data Scientists, to understand data needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions
Implement and enforce data governance policies, ensuring adherence to best practices in data security, integrity, privacy, and regulatory compliance
Contribute to and drive efforts to ensure high data quality across the organization by identifying and resolving issues in data pipelines and workflows
Participate in technical architecture discussions, offering expertise in designing scalable, efficient data systems.
Engage in peer code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and best practices
Who You Are
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
3+ years working as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role with a focus on building and maintaining data infrastructure and pipelines
Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS) REQUIRED and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing and working with cloud-based databases and analytics tools
REQUIRED: Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C#, Java, etc.) to automate data pipeline workflows
REQUIRED: Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow
Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts and ELT/ETL best practices
REQUIRED: Familiarity with source version control systems
REQUIRED: Strong SQL knowledge

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description
A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.
O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
Duties and Responsibilities:
· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;
· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;
· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;
· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;
· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;
· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;
· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;
· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;
· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;
· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);
Minimum Qualifications/Experience:
· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);
· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

description:
This role can be based in Sao Paulo OR Rio de Janeiro
Please submit a resume in English
Heidrick Consulting Brazil
You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.
You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as a Consultant, you will continue to learn and deepen your consulting skills by working on various projects. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.
Primary Responsibilities
The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.
You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.
Role Responsibilities:
Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.
The Ideal Candidate:
Passionate and Engaged:
Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.
Self-Driven and Inquisitive:
Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.
Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player:
Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.
Minimum Role Qualifications
2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
An undergraduate degree is required.
Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

title: Network Engineer Microwave
description:
ZTE Brazil is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Network Engineer (Microwave) to support project, commissioning, performance monitoring, and process standardization across telecom deployment and operations projects. This role will interface with clients such as TIM, Claro, and Vivo, ensuring compliance with internal methodologies and contractual obligations.
Key Responsibilities:
Use specialized software tools to simulate and optimize circuit performance, ensuring that components operate within the desired frequency range with high efficiency and low noise.
Determining the appropriate antenna type, calculating radiation patterns, and optimizing antenna impedance to maximize signal transmission and reception.
Develop complete microwave systems, integrating different components to meet specific performance requirements. This could involve designing a microwave communication link between two remote locations, considering factors such as distance, frequency allocation, and interference mitigation.
Use test equipment like network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and oscilloscopes to measure the performance of microwave components. They verify parameters such as gain, bandwidth, return loss, and phase noise to ensure that components meet design specifications.
Conduct tests on entire microwave systems in laboratory and field environments. This includes evaluating system performance under different operating conditions, such as varying temperatures, humidity levels, and signal strengths. They also perform interference testing to ensure the system can operate in a crowded electromagnetic environment without degradation.
Keep abreast of the latest research and technological advancements in microwave engineering, such as new materials, manufacturing techniques, and communication protocols.
Address complex technical problems in microwave systems, such as minimizing signal distortion, improving power efficiency, or reducing electromagnetic interference.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, IT or related fields.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Microwave Network Project, preferably within telecom or tech companies.
Strong understanding of project management tools, commissioning, prediction and executive reporting.
Previous experience working in multicultural environments or with Chinese organizations is a plus.
Advanced English is mandatory; Mandarin or Spanish is a differential.
Proficiency in Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, Power BI, Jira/Confluence.
Behavioral Competencies:
Work closely with cross - functional teams.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and methodical.
Strong interpersonal communication and collaborative mindset.
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
Initiative and ownership over assigned responsibilities.
Differentials:
Hands-on experience with field operations.
Prior knowledge of telecom vendors ecosystem and operational model in Brazil.
Our compensation package:

  • Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT) Outsourced.
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meals vouchers.
  • Health and Dental insurance.
  • Life insurance.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Extended paternity/maternity leave.
  • Gympass / Totalpass.
    This position is based in Rio de Janeiro, on-site model.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Visão Computacional Pleno
description:

Somos a maior plataforma de bigdata do mercado de veículos. Nossos produtos possuem foco na localização de veículos roubados, furtados e na verdadeira situação do bem localizado. Com foco em big data analytics, atuamos nos principais players do mercado automotivo como bancos, financeiras, locadoras e seguradoras.
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Visão Computacional Pleno para desenvolver e otimizar modelos de redes neurais aplicados a visão computacional. Se você tem experiência com visão computacional e processamento de imagens e curte resolver desafios complexos com visão computacional, essa vaga é pra você!
Você atuará com autonomia em projetos técnicos de ponta, como ALPR e detecção de fraude, utilizando tecnologias como PyTorch, CUDA, OpenVINO, ONNX — da pesquisa à entrega em produção.
ATIVIDADES DO DIA A DIA:
Trabalhar com modelos aplicados a image captioning, VQA (Visual Question Answering) e agentes internos de IA.
Desenvolvimento e otimização de modelos de redes neurais para aplicações práticas em visão computacional.
Leitura, interpretação e adaptação de artigos científicos para aplicação de soluções do estado da arte.
Implementação de pipelines completos de IA: preparação de dados, treinamento, validação, teste, deploy e fine tuning.
Aplicação de técnicas de aumento e balanceamento de dados para melhorar performance de modelos.
Manutenção e atualização de modelos em produção, garantindo performance e estabilidade.
Colaboração com times técnicos para definição de soluções escaláveis e eficientes.
Análise contínua de resultados e propostas de melhorias com foco em performance e acurácia.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:
Experiência mínima de 3 anos na área ou 2 anos com mestrado completo em áreas correlatas.
Sólido conhecimento em desenvolvimento e otimização de redes neurais com PyTorch.
Domínio da linguagem Python, com foco em aplicações de visão computacional.
Experiência com processamento de imagens utilizando
OpenCV e outras bibliotecas de processamento de imagem.
Conhecimento em ambientes Linux e versionamento de código com Git.
Familiaridade com drivers e bibliotecas Nvidia (CUDA, cudNN, TensorRT).
Experiência com ferramentas e frameworks como OpenVINO e ONNX
Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs com FastAPI
Capacidade de leitura, interpretação e aplicação de artigos científicos da área.
Perfil analítico, com interesse em pesquisa aplicada, testes e deploy em ambiente de produção.
DIFERENCIAIS:
Vivência em projetos de image captioning, VQA e aplicação de modelos com agentes internos de IA.
Contribuições em projetos open source ou publicações na área.
Experiência com otimização de modelos para edge devices.
NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

Plano de Saúde com coparticipação (SulAmérica)
Plano Odontológico
Dayoff no mês do aniversário
Seguro de vida

description:

– Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!
About the project:
At Nearsure, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.
These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.
With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.
As a
Data & Telemetry Architect , you will design and implement end-to-end observability and telemetry solutions that enhance system reliability, traceability, and performance monitoring across cloud and hybrid environments. This role combines hands-on engineering with architectural foresight to ensure that infrastructure and applications are fully instrumented and observable from day one. The expert will leverage leading platforms to deliver actionable insights from logs, metrics, and traces that support real-time troubleshooting, proactive monitoring, and data-driven operations.
This role collaborates closely with infrastructure teams, platform engineers, and application developers to embed telemetry best practices and support resilient, scalable digital platforms.
How your day-to-day work will look like:
Design, implement, and maintain scalable telemetry architectures that support distributed applications across multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid cloud environments.
Build and optimize observability pipelines using tools like Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, potentially integrating with or leveraging concepts from platforms like Splunk, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Grafana, and OpenTelemetry standards to collect, aggregate, and route data.
Develop structured logging and tracing strategies for microservices and distributed systems to support end-to-end visibility and root-cause analysis.
Configure data connectors and ingestion pathways to bring logs, metrics, and traces from various sources (including cloud provider native logs, application telemetry, and security tool outputs) into a centralized log aggregation platform, likely utilizing Microsoft Sentinel / Log Analytics workspace.
Help implement real-time alerting and dashboards (e.g., using Azure Monitor Workbooks or Sentinel Workbooks) for SRE, DevOps, and development teams to monitor key system health metrics, performance indicators, and security signals.
Standardize telemetry data collection across application tiers, containers, VMs, and cloud-native components using open standards where applicable.
Partner with development teams to embed observability into the software delivery lifecycle, supporting continuous improvement and faster incident resolution ("shift left").
Support log ingestion design, parsing rules, index strategy, and storage optimization for large-scale telemetry systems, balancing visibility needs with cost considerations.
Evaluate, integrate, and tune third-party observability platforms and logging agents, e.g. Vector, to enhance data collection capabilities.
Conduct telemetry health checks, identify data blind spots, and lead remediation strategies to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Collaborate closely with cloud security operations to integrate observability data and insights with tools like Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Sentinel, improving unified visibility, contextual risk analysis, and threat hunting capabilities related to system behavior.
Champion the automation of observability configurations and policy enforcement using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
Provide documentation, training, and support for internal teams on telemetry use cases and dashboards.
Ensure observability solutions meet relevant regulatory and compliance requirements by providing necessary audit trails and reporting capabilities.
This would make you the ideal candidate:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience in designing, implementing, and managing complex observability solutions in cloud environments.
Hands-on experience with logging and monitoring services across multiple cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP).
Deep expertise with Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
Proficiency in querying large datasets using Kusto Query Language (KQL) for analysis, reporting, and alerting.
Experience with structured logging, tracing, and monitoring strategies for distributed systems and microservices.
Experience with configuring data collection, including agents, diagnostic settings, and ingestion pipelines.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations for technical and security teams.
Proven expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or ARM templates for automating observability deployment and configuration.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and the principles of integrating monitoring and security checks ("shift left").
Familiarity with scripting and automation for data pipeline configuration (e.g., Python, Bash, Ansible).
Experience with various logging/telemetry agents and platforms beyond Azure-native, such as Splunk, ELK, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or specific agents like Vector.
Experience implementing structured logging in modern programming environments (e.g., .NET, Java, Python).
Solid understanding of SLAs, SLOs, and system reliability metrics as part of SRE practices.
Ability to interpret technical telemetry data and translate it into business-impacting insights.
Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills, particularly in cross-functional, DevOps-centric environments.
Experience in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, finance, healthcare) is a plus.
Experience supporting security investigations or threat hunting efforts with observability data.
Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.
What to expect from our Talent Connection process:

Contact:
Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.

Notification:
When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.
Transparency:
This process is direct and without intermediaries.
At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!
We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.
Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!
‍

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Full-Time/Remote)
description:
Smile is a national digital health company with almost 20 years in the industry, comprising 5 divisions including the National Dental Network, Health Fund Partnerships, Projects & Investments plus more recently, Retail Dental Cover and Corporate Dental Cover.
Smile is committed to revolutionising quality healthcare accessibility and affordability for the people of Australia. Smile is the top-rated dental cover in the country, offering Retail Dental Cover to the public and Corporate Dental Cover to companies and their teams across Australia.
Smile has been operating successfully with a globally distributed team since 2017.
The Role
ROLE OBJECTIVES
This performance profile seeks to attract a performance marketer with a proven track record of driving business growth using paid tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, TikTok, and other paid marketing platforms.
As a performance marketer, you will be accountable for driving revenue and sales for Retail Dental Cover and Corporate Dental Cover.
This role will be reporting to the Head of Marketing and will be a part of the Retail Dental Cover & Corporate Dental Cover Divisions. The position will have a full-time commitment of 40 hours per week with at least 6 hours of crossover b/w 8 am-5 pm GMT+10 (Brisbane, Australia)
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Campaign Development
Develop and execute paid search strategies aligned with business goals to increase member acquisition for our dental cover products across Google, Bing and other relevant search platforms.
Develop and execute paid social campaigns to acquire new members and retain existing ones.
Develop platform-specific ad creatives (videos and static) along with a detailed plan to drive revenue and sales across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant channels.
Campaign Optimisation
Continuously monitor, analyse, and optimise PPC campaigns to maximise ROI, improve click-through rates, and reduce cost per acquisition across platforms. This includes optimising targeting options, ad placements, and bidding strategies.
Collaborate with the sales team to align messaging and drive enterprise-level growth.
Conduct thorough keyword research to identify relevant search terms and opportunities. Manage keyword bids, ad copy, and landing page optimisation to enhance campaign performance across all advertising channels.
Monitor, develop and analyse paid social campaigns to maximise ROI and reduce cost per acquisition across platforms. This includes optimising the target audience, ad creative and landing pages.
Own the Complete Funnel
Develop ideas for generating leads and revenue through targeted Top, Middle & Bottom of the funnel campaigns.
Maintain a 360° view of the funnel, tracking everything from impressions to conversions on a daily basis.
Identify opportunities and troubleshoot issues at both the campaign and website levels to optimise performance.
Monitor key metrics and report insights regularly to drive timely improvements.
Work closely with stakeholders (design, content, and IT) to address and resolve the funnel-related concerns.
Budget Management
Effectively manage PPC and paid social budgets to ensure optimal allocation of funds across campaigns and channels, maintaining a balance between cost efficiency and performance.
Testing
Develop testing hypotheses and implement a prioritised testing plan to ensure continuous learning.
Coordinate A/B testing of ad copy, creative and bidding strategies to identify high-performing variations and improve overall campaign and company search performance.
Performance Reporting
Generate regular reports on key PPC metrics, including impressions, clicks, conversions, and cost per conversion across all advertising platforms. Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive continuous improvement in campaign performance.
Generate regular reports on key paid social campaign metrics. Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive continuous improvement in campaign performance.
Hunt for New Platforms
Explore new opportunities across paid platforms and channels to sustain and accelerate growth.
Drive revenue with a growth mindset - through structured experimentation programs, learn from failures and make data-driven decisions.
Collaboration & Communication
Collaborate with the designer & content manager to ensure creatives and communication are in line with brand guidelines.
Work closely with the SEO lead and the rest of the Growth Marketing team to align performance marketing strategies with organic search initiatives and overall marketing programs.
Communicate campaign performance, updates, and insights effectively to stakeholders.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
Acquisition (Grow SmileTMdental cover)
Drive month-on-month growth in dental cover sales by building and executing a scalable acquisition plan for SmileTM. Stay forward-looking, adapt confidently in ambiguity, and operate with a strong growth mindset to consistently achieve targets.
ROI (Return on Investment)
Measure the sales and revenue generated from individual platforms and campaigns. Track, monitor and improve the Lifetime Value of the customer, ensuring positive ROI for each campaign.
CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
Monitor and optimise the average cost incurred to acquire a new member or lead through campaigns, maximising new member acquisition within budget parameters.
Monitor and implement strategies to improve metrics across each stage of the acquisition funnel.
Ideal Profile
Requirements
This FULL-TIME ROLE will only suit someone who also meets the following requirements:
Has a passion for excelling in all they do, and this is evidenced in the extra references provided in your application.
Has extensive experience and evidence of achieving exceptional results with paid platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid social platforms.
Demonstrated success running successful Google ads and Meta ads is a must.
Should be analytical, strategic, and creative when the role requires it.
A growth mindset is essential - someone who embraces challenge, learns from feedback, and continuously seeks improvement.
Has perfectly spoken & written English.
Has the highest integrity.
If you believe you are a great fit for the role and meet ALL requirements above, we are looking forward to hearing from you!
What's on Offer?
100% Remote: Enjoy the flexibility and convenience of working from anywhere.
Full-Time Position: Secure a stable and consistent work schedule.
Similar Time Zone: Work seamlessly with a team in a compatible time zone.
Established Company: Join a nearly 20-year-old successful & growing organisation.
National Presence: Be part of a national Australian company.
Meaningful Work: Contribute to a noble mission to revolutionise quality healthcare accessibility and affordability.
Top-Tier Leadership & Team: Collaborate with 'A' leadership and 'A' players, including a successful Australian/Canadian Founder & CEO and a successful Silicon Valley CMO and a successful Head of Marketing from India.
Excellent Culture: Thrive in a positive and supportive work environment with a long-serving team.
Integrated Marketing Strategy: A company with a cohesive marketing strategy ensures that PPC and paid social campaigns align with broader marketing goals, improving overall campaign effectiveness and brand consistency.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti is
the
enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.
Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage.
Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.
As an innovative, global leader in Enterprise Data Management, the combination of our award-winning software platform and premier consultants creates a unique advantage for leading enterprises. Syniti is also a preferred data solution used by the world’s top system integrators. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.
The ROLE
The Senior Software Engineer assumes a leadership role in our technical endeavors, significantly shaping the architecture, design, and implementation of our systems. Apart from mastering our tech stack, they take pride in mentoring fellow engineers and proactively identifying areas of technical improvement, breaking down complex challenges into actionable tasks.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Lead technical projects, contributing to architecture, design, and system implementation.
Address and reduce technical debt proactively.
Mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
Break down and delegate complex problems for team execution.
WHAT IT TAKES
5+ years of relevant experience in full-stack software development.
Advanced full-stack skills including Go or C#, AWS, React, and Typescript/JS.
Advanced knowledge in SQL, NoSQL, or graph databases.
Proficiency with CI/CD and DevOps techniques and best practices.
Proficient in writing secure, production-ready code with a deep domain understanding.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and think strategically.
Operate with minimal supervision and be proactive in task leadership.
Significant impact on product quality and design simplification.
Be fully aligned to the our core values:
o Think Big
- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
o Be Curious
- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
o Take Action
- Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
o Stronger Together
- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust
that you are good at what you’re doing. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation . Hierarchies are not our thing and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen and ideas valued.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Engage in debugging and fixing software issues
Collaborate with the team on software architecture, design, and implementation

Begin to mentor and share knowledge with less experienced team members

Good understanding of software architecture, design principles, and best practices
Growing independence in task execution with occasional need for guidance
Effective team collaboration and communication skills
Be fully aligned to the our core values:
o Think Big
- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
o Be Curious
- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
o Take Action
- Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
o Stronger Together
- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

Trust
that you are good at what you’re doing. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

An open organisation . Hierarchies are not our thing and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen and ideas valued.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Design and solve challenging math problems to probe the limitations of large language models.
